KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.title: Tournament Cafeteria
KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.pages.INITI: Steam rises from long tables lined with trays. A vendor rolls a cart past: "Fighter portions left. Want a bite, or the full spread?"
Grab the free side dish. Heal 6 HP.
Spend 40 gold on mains and stew. Heal 12 HP.
You can't afford the full meal right now.
KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.pages.LIGHT: You polish off the small plate and heal 6 HP. Warmth settles in your stomach; you're ready for the next bout.
KAKAROT_TOURNAMENT_CAFETERIA.pages.FEAST: Soup, roast, and rice disappear in minutes. You pay 40 gold and heal 12 HP. The cost stings, but you feel completely restored.
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.title: An Incredible Tale
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.pages.INITI: Yellowed pages stir on their own. Two stories beckon. Begin at the meeting, or close the book at the farewell?
A boy and a girl meet, and a strange, beautiful journey begins. Upgrade 2 random cards in your deck.
Two heroes say goodbye, and a perfect story finds its ending. Lose 6 HP, then choose 2 cards in your deck to remove.
You need at least 2 removable cards in your deck to accept this ending.
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.pages.BEGIN: Soft light washes over your deck. Two cards grow stronger in the telling. The adventure turns a new page.
KAKAROT_INCREDIBLE_ADVENTURE.pages.GOODB: You pay the price: 6 HP lost, two cards gone forever. The final sentence lands, but the echo lingers.
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.title: The Emperor Arrives
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.pages.INITIA: Violet light tears open the sky above Namek. Frieza's army descends, and the emperor of the universe issues one final challenge to Goku.
Fully heal the team and face Frieza.
Skip the optional boss and continue to the normal ending.
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.pages.DECLIN: You leave the emperor's challenge unanswered. The journey through the Spire proceeds to its original conclusion.
KAKAROTMOD-FRIEZA_CHALLENGE.pages.VICTOR: Black Frieza collapses beneath the final blow. His presence vanishes, and the true victory is finally yours.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT_KORIN_TOWER_TRIAL.pag: Wind crosses the ancient stones at the top of the tower. Korin shakes the Sacred Water Jug, then points to a jar of Senzu Beans. "Choose carefully. Nothing up here comes without a lesson."
Lose 8 Max HP. Obtain the Sacred Water Jug.
You race Korin around the tower until your body reaches its limit. At last, you snatch the Sacred Water Jug from his hands.
Korin tosses you the jar. You catch it cleanly and secure the lifesaving reserve.
You leave the trial for another day. Korin strokes his whiskers and watches you depart.
